findings.summary: No declaration was found stating that the candidate's force has support in K×[0,2]; the exported candidate keeps only compact support in t>0. For the explicit force of NavierStokesR3.ActualCandidate.of_localized_fields, two public lemmas give support in [1/16,21/16]×outerSupport, and outerSupport strictly contains the exported K.

Proof-route difference only. Lean's force is timeCutoff·outerCutoff·F, with F the Taylor–Borel extension of the periodized, time-activated residual. The paper applies series (10.11) to the R³ limits F_j. The stated extension property is unchanged.
(10.5) defines f for 0 ≤ t < 1; Lean's navier_stokes clause covers t ∈ (0,1) only. This is a documented encoding choice, and agreement at t = 0 follows from the exported statement.
